_comment_MD060: Prettier owns table formatting (same stance as MD013 tables:false above, and as .sqlfluff:
'Line length is not enforced for SQL in this repo (consistent with Prettier owning width
elsewhere)'). MD060 and Prettier measure Thai differently — Thai vowels and tone marks are
combining characters, zero-width when rendered but one code point each — so on any table row
containing Thai they disagree about where the pipe belongs. Every MD060 hit in this repo was a
Thai row; there is no formatting that satisfies both tools, so the one that formats wins.
